title: Every Evil Food in the Dream – Be Consumed by Fire! Midnight Deliverance with Apostle Joshua Selman
paragraphs: Lift your hands wherever you are. Begin to bless the name of the Lord. Go ahead, lift your voice and magnify him. Thank him for his mercy, his faithfulness, his preservation. We bless you, mighty God. We give you glory, Jesus. We honor you, King of Kings and Lord of Lords. Let your voice rise like incense before the throne. You are Yahweh, the consuming fire. You are Yahweh, the great deliverer. You are Yahweh, the one who speaks and it comes to pass. Tonight, Father, let your fire fall.

Let there be deliverance in this place. Let there be liberty by the spirit. Let there be encounters that will never be forgotten. Hallelujah. I sense very strongly tonight that the Lord has come with fire. Not the fire that destroys his people, but the fire that purifies and judges the works of darkness. Somebody say, "Fire." Fire. Say it again. Fire. Yes. Tonight, by the power of the Holy Ghost, every eating in the dream, catch fire.

Every manipulation to spiritual food, every satanic exchange to eating in the dream tonight it comes under judgment in the name of Jesus. Lift your hands and pray in the spirit for one minute. Fire of the Holy Ghost. Hallelujah. Listen carefully. The realm of the spirit is a legal realm. Nothing happens there by accident. When you dream, you are not just imagining. You are encountering realities beyond the physical. Dreams are one of the languages of the spirit. Numbers 12 6.

If there be a prophet among you, I the Lord will make myself known unto him in a vision and will speak unto him in a dream. So the realm of dreams is a communication channel. God speaks through it. Angels appear through it. But also listen carefully. The devil can hijack that channel because whatever gate God uses, Satan tries to counterfeit. And one of the ways he does this is through spiritual eating in the dream.

Matthew 13:25 says, "But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tears among the wheat and went his way." There are things that happen while men sleep. Sleep is a mystery. It is both rest and vulnerability. That's why Psalm 91:5 says, "Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night." So hear me believers, if Satan cannot access you when you are awake, he will try when you sleep. And one of the ancient portals he uses is food. Because food is covenantal, food is spiritual, food is not just biological.

When God wants to establish relationship, he uses food. When Satan wants to manipulate destiny, he also uses food. Look at Genesis 3. And she took of the food thereof and did eat. That was the first eating that changed man's destiny. Not just what entered her stomach. IT WAS A COVENANT TRANSACTION. Because food in the spirit represents agreement and exchange. Hear me. Every time you eat in the dream, something is trying to enter you or something is trying to leave you.

It is either demonic deposit or virtue exchange. Sometimes your strength, your favor, your gifts can be stolen in that moment. But tonight I came with fire. I came with the sword of the spirit. I came with the mystery of the blood of Jesus. And I decree and declare every evil transaction that happened through eating in the dream, it is reversed now in the name of Jesus. every demonic covenant that was sealed to that meal be broken by fire.

Psalm 107:20 says, "He sent his word and healed them and delivered them from their destructions." As the word comes forth tonight, it will not only heal your body, it will heal your dreams, it will heal your foundation, it will heal your destiny. Listen carefully. In the realm of the spirit, eating represents participation. When the Bible says in 1 Corinthians 10 verse 21, you cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of devils, that means there is a communion in both kingdoms.

Every time there is eating in the dream, there is an attempt to make you partake in another table. Not the Lord's table, but the table of demons. That's why Psalm 23:5 says, "Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies." That means there are tables in the spirit. And if God can prepare a table, the enemy can also prepare one. SO NOT EVERY table is divine. Hear me. When you see yourself eating strange foods in the dream is not always just a dream.

Sometimes is an altar of witchcraft trying to feed your destiny poison. Sometimes is an ancestral spirit renewing a covenant through feeding. Sometimes is an arrow of infirmity sent into your system through dream meals. But I stand by the authority of the blood of Jesus. Every poison you have eaten in the spirit, come out by fire. I SAID COME OUT BY FIRE by the blood of the lamb. I decree and declare every demonic meal assigned to your spirit be reversed in the name of Jesus by the sword of the spirit.

We break that covenant. Now lift your voice and begin to pray. Lord, whatever was transferred into my life to eat it in the dream by your mercy and by your fire, let it be reversed. Now go ahead and pray. FIRE OF DELIVERANCE, FIRE OF PURIFICATION. Let every spiritual contamination be cleansed in the name of Jesus. Hallelujah. Tonight the Lord is not only delivering people from evil dreams. He is cleansing the spiritual digestive system of men.

Because some of you after every eating dream you wake up weak, heavy, drained. That's not normal. That's a signal of exchange. Virtues have been withdrawn. But tonight there is restoration. Joel 2 25. And I will restore to you the years that the locust has eaten. I decree and declare whatever the devil has eaten in your life, let there be restoration. Your health restored, your finances restored, YOUR GIFTS RESTORED, YOUR FIRE FOR GOD restored in the name of Jesus Christ. Lift your hands high.

We're going to make decrees now. Every time we speak, the fire of God will fall. Say after me, in the name of Jesus, in the name of I declare that my dreams are sanctified. In the name of Jesus, no altar of darkness shall feed me again. Every covenant of evil feeding, break now. Break now. EVERY POWER THAT FEEDS ME IN THE NIGHT, CATCH fire by the anointing of the Holy Ghost. Let fire fall on every satanic kitchen in the spirit. Let every demonic cook be arrested by angels of judgment.

Let every spiritual spoon, PLATE, POT MELT BY FIRE IN THE NAME of Jesus. SOMEBODY SHOUT FIRE. SAY IT AGAIN. FIRE. I decree and declare from tonight your dream life is under the government of the Holy Ghost. Only Jesus shall appear to you. Only angels of light shall minister to you. No more satanic restaurants. No more demonic tables. No more eating in the dream. By the blood of Jesus. YOUR SPIRITUAL MOUTH is purified. Your sleep is sanctified. Your mind is covered by the blood.

Your nights are secured by the angels of the Lord. Psalm 91 11. For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways. I decree from tonight you are kept. Your nights are kept. Your body is kept. Your destiny is kept. Lift your hands and begin to thank him. We give you glory Jesus. You have delivered us from the snare of darkness. You have broken the evil tableab. You are Yahweh, the consuming fire. You are the mighty deliverer. Hallelujah.

Just lift your hands wherever you are and begin to pray in the Holy Ghost. Let the fire keep burning. The spirit of deliverance is still moving. I sense the angels of deliverance walking through this atmosphere. Listen, deliverance doesn't just happen when hands are laid. Deliverance happens when light comes. Deliverance happens when truth collides with darkness. Deliverance happens when revelation meets ignorance and shatters it by power. And tonight, the light of God is shining on your dream life. Hear me.

No more eating in the dream. No more covenants renewed in ignorance. Every manipulation in your night season, it ends tonight. Say, "It ends tonight." Say it louder. IT ENDS TONIGHT. HALLELUJAH. Let me teach you for a few minutes before we pray. Pay attention because revelation precedes restoration. In the spirit, food is never neutral. Food is a vehicle for transfer. That's why in both divine and demonic systems, eating is used to seal covenants.

When Jesus instituted the communion in Matthew 26:26, he said, "Take, eat. This is my body," he was not giving them ordinary bread. He was giving them participation in his covenant. That's why Paul said in 1 Corinthians 11 26, "As often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord's death till he comes." That means spiritual eating connects you to a spiritual system. If it is the table of the Lord, it brings life. If it is the table of demons, it brings bondage.

So when a person eats in the dream, it can mean one, a covenant renewal with ancestral altars. Two, a transfer of virtue. Something valuable is taken from you. Three, a deposit of darkness, sickness, fear, or oppression enters. Four, a cancellation of progress. Demonic systems mark you for delay. But tonight, by the blood that speaks better things than the blood of Abel, every covenant, every transfer is being transfer is being destroyed by fire. Say by fire. Listen carefully.

Spiritual eating is one of Satan's oldest tricks. When he came to Eve, he didn't bring a sword, he brought a food. When he came to Jesus in Matthew 4, he said, "Turn these stones into bread." He knows the power of feeding. Satan is aware that what you eat, you become part of. That's why he feeds men with deception, fear, lust, sickness, and in the dream he feeds them to make it legal. But the Bible says in Isaiah 49:4, "Shall the prey be taken from the mighty or the lawful captive delivered."

Verse 25 says, "But thus sayeth the Lord, even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away." That means even lawful captives can be delivered. EVERY LEGAL RIGHT SATAN had over your destiny, tonight it is broken. Somebody shout broken. Say it again. Broken. Amen. Hallelujah. As I speak now, the fire of deliverance is moving across households. There are some of you, your eating dreams are not random. Every time you are about to rise, you will eat in the dream and everything stops. You apply for contracts.

That night, you eat food in the dream. You plan to fast that night. THEY FEED YOU and you break your fast in the spirit. It's not ordinary. It's an altar of resistance. But tonight I stretch my hands as a servant of the most high. Every altar of witchcraft that has been feeding your destiny poison, catch fire now in the name of Jesus. Shandalo by the power of the Holy Ghost.

Let every spiritual kitchen be destroyed, every demonic cook arrested BY ANGELS OF JUDGMENT, EVERY PLATE OF WITCHCRAFT SHATTERED BY THE SWORD of the spirit. Hear me. Some of you after tonight, you will dream again, but this time fire will appear in your dreams. You will see the same table they used to feed you, and fire will consume it before your eyes. That's how you will know deliverance has happened. You will see those demonic agents running away from you. You will see yourself rejecting the food.

You will see yourself praying in tongues inside the dream. That's victory in the spirit. Say, I receive victory. Let's look at a few scriptures. Psalm 18:8. There went up a smoke out of his nostrils and fire out of his mouth devoured. Coals were kindled by it. This means when God arises, he arises with fire. Hebrews 12:29, for our God is a consuming fire. That means the nature of God himself is fire, holy fire, cleansing fire, consuming fire. Isaiah 10 17.

And the light of Israel shall be for a fire and his holy one for a flame. And it shall burn and devour his thorns and briars in one day. That means the Lord burns demonic plans that have been planted in your spiritual system. Jeremiah 15: es 21. I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked and I will redeem you from the grasp of the terrible. These scriptures are not suggestions. They are verdicts. As you shout amen, they become laws in the realm of the spirit.

I decree and declare every satanic manipulation to food end now. Every poison IN YOUR BODY COME out now. Every virtue stolen be restored now. EVERY ANCESTRAL covenant renewed through food be broken now. EVERY SICKNESS connected to dream feeding dry up now. Deliverance is happening right now. Thus said the spirit of God. I am bringing healing to your dreams. I am restoring the purity of your night seasons. No longer shall you eat from demonic tables. No longer shall darkness access your rest.

There's a woman, the Lord says your name is patience. You have been eating in dreams for years. Sometimes it is your late grandmother who serves you food. The Lord says that covenant of death is broken. Now there's a man, your name is John. Every time you dream, you are in a strange village eating with unknown people. The Lord says, "I have cut you off from ancestral altars. You are free." There's someone watching from Ghana. The Lord says that stomach pain you always feel after those dreams is leaving you now.

Receive your deliverance in the name of Jesus. Lift your right hand and declare in the name of Jesus. Every poison IN MY SYSTEM COME OUT BY FIRE. Every demonic meal assigned against my life CATCH FIRE. EVERY AGENT OF DARKNESS that feeds me at night, your assignment is over. Now I decree, let fire move through your dreams. Let fire move through your memories. Let fire move through your mind. Let fire move THROUGH YOUR BLOOD. LET FIRE MOVE THROUGH YOUR FAMILY. LET FIRE MOVE THROUGH YOUR FOUNDATION.

Psalm 97:3, a fire goeth before him and burneth up his enemies roundabout. That means wherever God moves, fire precedes him. So from tonight when you sleep, the fire of God will go before you. When you close your eyes, the fire of the Holy Ghost will stand guard OVER YOUR BED. EVERY TIME they attempt to approach, they will meet a wall of flames. Somebody shout fire seven times. Fire. Fire. Fire. Fire. Fire. Now pray in tongues for 1 minute. Shandala bratalia. I release fire in your dream gates. Fire on your head.

Fire in your mind, fire in your body, fire on your pillows, FIRE ON YOUR BED, FIRE in your sleep. From tonight, your night is holy ground. From tonight, no demon shall approach your atmosphere. From tonight, the spirit of the Lord surrounds you like a wall of fire. Zechariah 2:5. For I, sayeth the Lord, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her. I decree that wall of fire around your house, around your children, around your business, around your destiny.

Lift your hands and begin to worship him. You are the God who answers by fire. You are the Lord who delivers without residue. You are the lion of the tribe of Judah. We give you praise, mighty deliverer. We give you honor, great redeemer. Let your glory fill this house. Lord, thank you for setting your people free. Thank you because tonight the gates of hell are trembling, dreams are being sanctified, minds are being renewed, bodies are being healed, and destinies are being restored. Lift your hands.

Keep praying in the Holy Ghost. Something is happening already. Chande Calabroso, Eltosia, Mandebra. I see fire everywhere. Chains are breaking. Altars are shaking. The Lord says, "I am overturning ancient covenants. I am rewriting histories tonight." Say, "Lord, overturn it." Listen carefully. An altar is a place of meeting between the spirit and the physical. Every altar has a voice. Every altar has a demand. Some of you were born into families where food was used to raise demonic altars.

They offered sacrifices with food, blood, and wine. And those covenants still speak. So when you eat in the dream, the altar says, "Our covenant still stands." But hear me, there is a superior altar. Hebrews 13:10 says, "We have an altar whereof they have no right to eat." That means there is an altar in Christ higher than any ancestral table. Tonight we are enforcing the voice of that altar. Psalm 50:5 says, "Gather my saints together unto me, those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice."

Your covenant with Jesus is higher than any ancestral covenant by the blood of THE ETERNAL COVENANT. EVERY OTHER covenant collapses now. Somebody shout collapse. Lift your right hand and shout this loud in the name of Jesus. Amen. Every covenant made on my behalf, knowingly or unknowingly, through food, sacrifice, or communion with darkness, I renounce you now. I break you by the blood of Jesus. I disconnect myself and my family line. Now hear me. by the apostolic mantle of deliverance.

I decree every ancestral covenant of affliction, baroness, delay, poverty, and sickness, break now. Every inherited altar that feeds you in the dream, catch fire now. Every spirit that visits you at night, lose your grip in the name of Jesus. Isaiah 28:18 says, "Your covenant with death shall be disanolled and your agreement with hell shall not stand." That means even if there was a covenant with death, it can be cancelled.

I decree tonight your covenant with death, sickness, delay, failure disanolled in Jesus' name. Listen, many of you are fighting battles older than you. These are foundational issues, but there is a mystery of foundation repair. Psalm 11:3 says, "If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?" Verse four answers, "The Lord is in his holy temple." That means when foundations shake, you run to the altar of God. Stretch your hands toward the altar right now.

Say, "Lord Jesus, rebuild my foundation by the power of the Holy Ghost. I decree every faulty spiritual foundation in your life be rebuked by fire. Every evil structure sustaining dream manipulation collapse now. EVERY SHRINE where your name IS BEING MENTIONED, THUNDER FROM HEAVEN, answer them. Shandrosia sayeth the spirit of God, I AM CUTTING OFF the root of recurring oppression. The chain that bound your mother that TIED YOUR FATHER shall not tie you. You are the interruption to that pattern.

If you believe it, shout amen. Amen. Now hear this. After deliverance comes restoration. Because when you were fed in the dream, something was taken. maybe your favor, your wisdom, your health, your financial doors, your marriage. But Job 42 10 says, "And the Lord restored Job when he prayed." Lift your voice and declare, "Father, restore. Whatever was stolen from me to dream feeding, restore by fire." I decree and declare, every stolen star, return. Every lost virtue return. Every stolen glory return.

EVERY SWALLOWED BLESSING VOMIT IT OUT BY FIRE. Jeremiah 51:44. And I will make Babylon vomit out what she has swallowed. Therefore, everything the enemy has swallowed, vomit it now. I command restoration of dream purity, divine health, spiritual gifts, FINANCIAL FAVOR, marital grace, PROPHETIC VISION, PRAYER FIRE. RECEIVE IT IN the name of Jesus. The spirit of God is healing
practice: If a troubling dream stays with you, take a moment to notice where you are now. Read Psalm 4:8 and tell God what frightened you without treating the dream as a verdict.
